relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: Patients with severe pain exhibited significantly lower TNFα levels (p=0.04) and trended toward lower IL-6 levels (p=0.07) and substance P levels (p=0.06) compared to no or moderate pain (Table 3).

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Interestingly, patients with lower levels of these markers but higher IL-8, IL-4 and CGRP levels tended to fall into the severe pain category.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP, released from both sensory neurons and endothelial cells drives vasodilation and neurogenic inflammation.

key_findings: Serum cytokine/neuropeptide profiles cluster with chronic pancreatitis pain patterns: high IL-1β, IL-6, IL-2, TNFα, MCP1 with constant mild-moderate pain; high IL-4, IL-8, CGRP with severe pain
Severe and constant pain patients unexpectedly had lower circulating TNFα
